qa_pairs.question: What testers are required for testing the on-board computer Generation II?
qa_pairs.answer: Universal adapter with connecting lead as well as BMW service test unit (multimeter tests).

qa_pairs.question: What are the different ignition lock positions and their functions for the on-board computer?
qa_pairs.answer: 0: No display background lighting, not possible to operate buttons. R: Display board illuminated, operation possible, code function free. 15: Same as R, however also distance/time/consumption functions, code function locked. 50: Same as 15, but in this case the starting interlock must only function 6 seconds after taking away the term. 50 signal.

qa_pairs.question: What is the universal adapter HWB number and its associated connection pins?
qa_pairs.answer: Universal adapter HWB No. 81 12 9 425 091, with Conn. lead wire harness 26-pin 096 and Conn. lead control unit 26-pin 097.

qa_pairs.question: How can you call the type of coding plug in ignition lock position 15?
qa_pairs.answer: The type of coding plug can be called in ignition lock position 15 by pressing buttons 1 and 100 simultaneously. If calling is not possible, check power supply between pins 10 (= B -) and 7 (= term. 15).

qa_pairs.question: What should you do if PPPP appears in the display due to a problem in the coding plug on back?
qa_pairs.answer: Replace coding plug, disconnect power supply, reconnect, perform coding test.

qa_pairs.question: What does AAAA appearing in the display indicate?
qa_pairs.answer: AAAA appears in display indicates an internal BC II defect. The solution is to replace BC II; also refer to point 1.

qa_pairs.question: What voltage specification should be checked between pins 10 and 6 when there is no display?
qa_pairs.answer: When there is no display due to power supply missing, check between pin 10 (= B-) and pin 6 (= B+). Specification: U ≥ 10 V.

qa_pairs.question: What causes a weak time display with no other operations possible in ignition lock position R?
qa_pairs.answer: This can be caused by no voltage on term. R or BC II defective (e.g. buttons). Check between pin 10 (= B-) and pin 5 (= term. R). Specification: U ≥ 10 V.

qa_pairs.question: How is data stored in the on-board computer II cancelled?
qa_pairs.answer: Data stored in on board computer II is cancelled with the connecting switch of the test adapter (between BC II wire harness plug and BC II).

qa_pairs.question: What should be checked regarding the fuel transmitter if BC II needs to be replaced?
qa_pairs.answer: After replacing BC II check coding and compensate reserve volume: If the tank volume does not equal reserve volume, pull the fuel level transmitter out of tank far enough that float is on bottom stop. Remove anti-tamper lock on BC II (left side next to button 1000). Ignition lock in position 15. Correct the displayed liter value with a screwdriver after pressing buttons 1 and 1000 simultaneously. Reinstall anti-tamper lock.
